title: Political Suicide
summary: A government official is implicated in a scandal by being involved with an intern. He seemingly commits suicide by shooting himself.
method: The killer shot the victim in his office and stayed in the room, later pretending to walk onto the scene when the body is found. The suicide note is valid because the victim intended to run away from his scandals and start a new life by faking his death.
motive: The killer discovered that the victim was going to fake his death and run away.
notes:
Appearance of Camille's dad Marlon. His god daughter is the intern. 
The timeline also doesn't make sense. They say he left when Camille was 6 and this was 20 years ago, making Camille in her mid-20s.
